author: opencode-worker-2
text: Root-cause correction while executing: puck does NOT enable LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_STANDALONE (Kconfig default n; absent from puck prj.conf and all board confs) — so main.c:522's init(NULL) block is dead code today and the 4.04s are caused by the missing server, not the NULL handlers (NULL is the correct call for the built-in resources; the service registers /status,/config,/neighbors,/msg/inbox statically, coap_server.c:451). Re-scoping this child to the full minimal Kconfig slice: CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER=y + CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_STANDALONE=y + CONFIG_COAP_SERVER=y + CONFIG_COAP_SERVER_WELL_KNOWN_CORE=y + CONFIG_COAP_SERVER_MESSAGE_SIZE=896 (BUILD_ASSERT requires >= LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_MAX_PAYLOAD(512)+128=640; gateway uses 896). The NULL-handler premise in child .3 is therefore resolved by this child.
